summary: Virudhagiri is a 2010 Indian Tamil-language action film written and directed by Vijayakanth, who also played the title role in his directorial debut. Co-starring Madhuri Itagi, Arun Pandian and Mansoor Ali Khan, it was released on 10 December 2010. The note calls it one of Vijaykanth's finest works and one of the biggest blockbusters of Tamil cinema, and says it was later dubbed into Hindi as Inspector Dabangg. It is a remake of the French film Taken.
one_line: Virudhagiri is a 2010 Tamil action film directed by and starring Vijayakanth, a box-office blockbuster and remake of the French film Taken.
